title: MZ Getting rid off useless stats in item's menu

posts.author: Swaggerino420
posts.body: So I have a plugin Visumz ItemsEquipCore and I would like to get rid off the Type, Accuracy, Speed and Hit descriptions for the items (healing items), and for materials Consumable description.

posts.author: Angy1910
posts.body: Have you found a solution? I'm also searching for a way to decide which stats to show.

posts.author: CalculatorCat
posts.body:
You can change this in the plugin settings.
Look for "Shop Status Window" under the parameters, then "JS: Draw Item Data".
In that section, look for the comment //Draw Remaining Item Properties
You can edit anything about that section in that code. I removed some of those things from displaying by just inserting // at the beginning of the relevent line of code.
